title: A Terraform state file is served
summary: The Terraform state is downloadable.  It records the infrastructure and commonly holds secrets in plain text.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and body_contains("terraform_version") and body_contains("resources") and body_differs(control)

remediate: Keep state in a secured backend, never in the web root; rotate any secret it held.
